summary.text: Michael Scott is the Democratic candidate for the Maine State Senate, District 20, in the November 3, 2026 general election, after advancing from the June 9, 2026 Democratic primary.
A retired Auburn firefighter, he said in a Ballotpedia survey that he reached the rank of Battalion Chief and served as president of the Professional Fire Fighters of Maine.

paragraphs.text: Michael Scott earned a high school diploma from Oak Hill High School and is retired.
In his survey response, he said he grew up in Sabattus, joined the Sabattus Fire Department at age 14, and moved to Auburn about 30 years ago.
He said he joined the Auburn Fire Department in 1996, worked his way up to Battalion Chief and retired in 2026 after 30 years of service.
Scott described his years as a union leader, including as president of the Professional Fire Fighters of Maine.
He listed affordability, education and safe communities as his key campaign messages, and said he is married with two daughters who attended Auburn schools.
